title: Spotify — Customer Service Platform
sourceNote: Role brief paraphrased from the public job listing. The saved result is public evidence coverage, not a hiring decision.
roleBrief: Product Manager for a customer-service platform. Own advisor tools, support channels, a reliable API layer, responsible AI and automation, discovery-to-launch work, and evidence-led prioritisation with engineering, design, data, and service operations.

assessment.summary: The public portfolio shows evidence across product framing, workflow design, AI-native execution, evidence synthesis, operational collaboration, technical delivery, and business prioritisation. The role-specific evidence connects this to customer-service tooling, API layers, workflow automation, and experimentation.
roleNeeds: own the vision and roadmap for tools used by support advisors
improve the advisor experience and how customers access support
strengthen the API layer connecting support systems
identify responsible applications of AI and automation in advisor workflows
define success metrics and run experiments
